display_name: Help desk password resets: spot it
description: An awareness episode of about 8 minutes for IT service desk staff, on the defending side only. Sit in the service desk seat at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional company: three callers want password resets or changes to their sign-in, and a sign-in prompt turns up on your own phone. Each answer is explained, and ringing back when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
